description: Holds WTI crude oil futures while the 20-day average is above the 100-day average, cash otherwise. Backtested on FinzData futures: each market is its front-month contract rolled on the FinzData roll calendar, as an excess-return index (no interest on collateral), 5 bps costs per trade, re-run free on full history.
title: /CL 20/100 moving-average trend
